brief.offer: Paid search campaigns for privacy-focused software products

facts.claim: Plausible offers white-label analytics for SaaS platforms, website builders, and marketplaces, with dashboards embedded in customers’ products.
facts.excerpt: SaaS platforms can add analytics as a maintained product feature without building a separate collection and reporting system. Customers stay inside your interface and see a dashboard that already feels familiar.
facts.source_title: White label web analytics for SaaS platforms and website builders | Plausible Analytics

facts.claim: Plausible reports having more than 21,000 paying customers.
facts.excerpt: why over 21,000 paying customers trust us with their website and business insights:
facts.source_title: Plausible Analytics | Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative

facts.claim: Plausible crossed $1 million in annual recurring revenue in 2022 and says it has continued to grow as a profitable, independently operated company.
facts.excerpt: Plausible crossed $1 million in annual recurring revenue in 2022 and has continued to grow as a profitable, independently operated company.

facts.claim: Plausible says its analytics does not use cookies or process personal data, and that visitor data is processed on servers owned and operated by European companies and never leaves the EU.
facts.excerpt: All visitor data is exclusively processed on servers owned and operated by European companies and never leaves the EU.
facts.source_title: Plausible Analytics | Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative

facts.claim: Plausible says it can serve thousands of customers and new trials without dedicated support personnel, aided by a minimal, easy-to-use product.
facts.excerpt: The product itself being minimal and easy to use makes it possible for us to serve thousands of customers and new trials without being overwhelmed with messages.
facts.source_title: How we scaled support for 4,000+ subscribers and 1,000+ monthly trials (without dedicated support personnel) | Plausible Analytics

facts.claim: Plausible provides a Stats API as an option for customers building a custom analytics interface.
facts.excerpt: Stats API for a custom interface
facts.source_title: White label web analytics for SaaS platforms and website builders | Plausible Analytics

research.website_note: The results identify plausible.io as Plausible Analytics’ official website.
research.gaps: Specific pricing information and recent funding or hiring details are not provided.

strategy.observation: Plausible says its analytics uses no cookies or personal-data processing, and visitor data stays on servers operated by European companies within the EU.
strategy.offer_link: Paid search could reach people actively comparing privacy-focused analytics products and test messaging around Plausible’s stated privacy and EU data-processing distinctions.
hypotheses: Plausible may want to reach more prospective customers who are searching for alternatives to analytics products that use cookies or process personal data.
Search campaigns may be a channel Plausible is willing to test or expand.
strategy.angle: With Plausible’s no-cookie approach and EU-only data processing, paid search could target teams comparing privacy-focused analytics options.
strategy.fit_reason: The offer directly serves privacy-focused software, and Plausible’s stated product attributes provide relevant themes for search targeting and campaign messaging.

draft.subject: Search for privacy-focused analytics
draft.body:
Plausible’s no-cookie analytics and EU-only data processing give searchers a concrete distinction when comparing analytics tools.

I run paid search campaigns for privacy-focused software products. A focused test could reach teams searching for cookie-free analytics or EU-based data processing, if that’s a buyer segment you want to grow.

Would you consider testing a small paid search campaign around those themes?
